signals.title: Can-Am claims to have the solution to saving money on two wheels
signals.summary: Can-Am says bikers could save around £2,700 by switching from a combustion engine motorcycle to electric. Next month’s MCL26 show is set to feature an appearance from the Canadian company Can-Am, with the electric motorcycle maker wishing to challenge “conventional thinking about the cost of life on two wheels”. In 2022, Can-Am launched its first new motorcycles in 35 years, with both the Origin dual-sport and Pulse roadster models. And it's through these two motorcycles that the company wants to provide bikers with more information on how to make life on two wheels more affordable. With fuel prices continuing to rise and showing no signs of slowing down, owning a motorcycle is becoming more and more expensive. However, Can-Am says that switching to electric bikes offers several cost-saving measures. According to Can-Am, “the savings show that energy and maintenance costs for a petrol-powered motorcycle come to £3,900, compared with just £1,200 for an electric alternative, a potential saving of £2,700”. It goes on to say that bikers should look beyond the initial purchase price when deciding to buy their next motorcycle, as the long-term impacts can vary quite substantially. As part of its appearance at MCL26, Can-Am will showcase its Origin and Pulse motorcycles, as well as models from its three-wheel range. Speaking ahead of the event, which takes place at the NEC in Birmingham on November 21-29, Mike Loach, district commercial manager of Bombardier Recreational Products (BRP), which owns Can-Am, said: “The Origin and Pulse offer a fresh approach to life on two wheels. We want to open up the conversation on EV bikes so riders are fully informed about whether to make the switch from petrol or are simply curious about what electric motorcycling has to offer. We want to show them the potential benefits of Can-Am EV bikes, from lower running costs to an exciting new riding experience.” The Can-Am Pulse comes with four different riding modes: Normal, ECO, Rain and Sport+, which riders can switch between depending on their location, personal preference and the weather. The Pulse also makes use of BRP’s Active ReGen system, providing riders with enhanced control and smoother deceleration. Meanwhile, the Origin has six drive modes that adjust rider aids including throttle response, traction control, and ABS depending on the ride. Situated inside the six modes are two off-road modes that help the bike transition from road to off-road. signals.title: This wild electric hypersport concept isn’t actually heading for production, or is it?
signals.summary: Meet the Cellcius C-01, a new electric hypersport motorcycle concept from Australian company, Clandestine Design Group, but is it actually heading for production? It might not look like any motorcycle concept that’s come before it, but don’t be fooled, this Cellcius C-01 E-Hypersport motorcycle is not just for show. What sets the Cellcius C-01 apart from all other electric motorcycle concepts that have come before it is the battery layout, which includes eight swappable cells. These are the four attachments that can be found on each side of the motorcycle’s main body. At the time of this writing, the Clandestine Design Group, which is behind the E-Hypersport concept, has not yet confirmed whether the motorcycle is heading for production, or what the bike’s price will be. Instead of having one battery pack like conventional electric bikes, the cells represent a more unique approach. Each cell produces three kWh, giving the bike a total of 24 kWh, while the idea behind it is to allow the rider the choice of how many to carry when riding. The more cells used will therefore result in more power and performance, and according to reports, the full weight of the bike with all eight cells installed is 220kg. Another theory behind this concept is to make the bike lighter than if it was using a traditional single battery unit, which adds weight, although it does tend to bring more range. The new concept is designed for anyone with easy access to charging sockets from home, as its charging system does not require the need for a garage. People renting apartments can just as easily charge the individual cells from a regular wall socket, while also transporting them in a backpack to places like coffee shops. signals.title: Chinese dominance: EICMA 2026 to welcome nine new bikes from Benda
signals.summary: Chinese motorcycle manufacturer Benda is set to reveal a plethora of new bikes at EICMA 2026 in November. Benda has revealed plans to introduce nine brand-new motorcycles at next month’s EICMA show in Milan, Italy, three of which will open brand-new categories for the brand. What those models will be remains a mystery at this stage, however, the Chinese motorcycle maker has not yet experimented with the adventure, supersport or modern classic platforms. And with Benda confirming three all-new platforms, we could see at least one of these segments become home to a new model from the company. Until now, Benda has largely operated as a manufacturer that builds modern-day cruisers, with the range currently topped by the Dark Flag 900. The Rock 707, LFC 700 and 700 Pro, Dark Flag 500, Napoleonbob 500 and 250, alongside the Chinchilla 500 and 250 CVT, are just some of the models that reside within the brand’s extensive cruiser range. You might like to read our Benda LFC 700 review . In terms of the company’s plans for EICMA, Benda shared a tease on social media, if you can call it that, saying: “Nine new models. Three new categories. A new perspective. “At EICMA 2026, Benda moves into new territory. Three of our nine new models open new categories for the brand. Three were designed by European designers, for European riders.” What we can take from that, at least, is that Benda clearly has big plans to bring many of its new models to the UK and Europe. One of those bikes could be the Benda Rover 500, which despite its comical British-related name, is a reported middleweight cruiser that includes a V-twin engine, although no displacement figures have been shared aside from the bike’s name. Those eager to see Benda’s new motorcycle line-up won’t have long to wait with EICMA set to get underway on November 3. signals.title: WorldSBK legend takes part in special parade lap for children’s charity
signals.summary: Jonathan Rea has helped raise money for the Cancer Fund for Children charity, after riding a Honda CBR1000RR-R around a football pitch. Six-time WorldSBK champion Jonathan Rea was amongst 200 participants from Northern Ireland’s wider football family that came together in support of the Cancer Fund for Children charity last weekend. Rea, who was testing Honda’s 2027 WorldSBK-spec CBR1000RR-R a few days prior at Jerez, was seen riding a road-legal version of the superbike at the event. Rea completed a lap of the football pitch at the Clearer Twist National Stadium at Windsor Park last Sunday, which celebrated the 10-year partnership between the Irish Football Association and the Cancer Fund for Children charity. A mix of players, coaches, numerous footballing greats and other sporting legends, families and supporters all came together in support of the charity, which has raised more than £176,000 raised over the last decade. The event included the Road to Daisy Lodge GAWA Relay, where participants combined to complete 120 laps of the football pitch. The distance covered was equivalent to the journey between Belfast and Daisy Lodge, which is the charity's therapeutic centre in Newcastle, County Down. Cancer Fund for Children has been the official charity partner of the Football Association of Ireland, and together, they have set an ambitious target of reaching £200,000 by the end of 2026. Former captain of the Northern Ireland team, Steven Davis, said this about the partnership: “The partnership began in 2016, which was a special year for Northern Ireland football as we competed at the European Championship in France. There was a real sense of togetherness around the team and our supporters, and it’s great to see that spirit continuing through a partnership that has raised so much for such an important cause. “Playing for Northern Ireland was a huge privilege, and I know how much football can bring people together. signals.title: KTM reveals new sport-touring models as part of 2027 motorcycle range
signals.summary: First unveiled at EICMA 2024, KTM’s latest-generation 1390 Super Duke GT is finally coming to dealerships worldwide. KTM has revealed its new 2027 motorcycle range which will be on full display at next month’s EICMA show in Milan, Italy. The new line-up will include the Austrian brand’s latest-generation 1390 Super Duke GT, which was first unveiled at EICMA 2024. The new 1390 Super Duke GT was initially revealed as a 2025 model, however, KTM delayed production of the sports tourer, and many other models, due to its financial crisis which began two years ago. But with KTM returning to profit for the first time in two years this summer, things are now looking up for the Bajaj Auto-owned company. The all-new 1390 Super Duke GT receives the same 8.8-inch touchscreen TFT display as its predecessor, although it now features offline onboard map navigation, while a standard adjustable screen and integrated SP Connect mount round out the bike’s package. According to KTM, seat comfort has also been reworked for riders spending longer days in the saddle, while the standard model is also joined by an Evo version. The 2027 1390 Super Duke GT Evo features all of the above, as well as KTM’s Automated Manual Transmission (AMT), which removes the need for a clutch, giving riders the choice between manual gear selection or fully automatic shifting. KTM says a broad selection of its new motorcycles will be displayed at EICMA, which begins on November 3, before heading to MCL26 at the NEC in Birmingham. Joining the new sport-touring models within KTM’s 2027 line-up are the 1390 Super Duke R and 1390 Super Duke R Evo nakeds, both of which gain new colourways. They also feature the same upgraded 8.8-inch touchscreen TFT dashboard as the Super Duke GT. Stopping power is also enhanced with an updated Brembo HyPure caliper setup. KTM has not shared any images of its 2027 models thus far, but we can expect that to change at EICMA. A new 390 Adventure R will be joined by the 2027 790 Adventure bike, as well as an updated 390 Adventure X, which is set to be revealed after EICMA. signals.title: 城市通勤、跑山压弯、户外撒野三个愿望一次满足，新大洲本田NS150XC体验一车三用
signals.summary: 城市通勤、跑山压弯、户外撒野三个愿望一次满足，新大洲本田NS150XC体验一车三用 新大洲本田在踏板车型的研发上，无论是外观塑造还是动力调校，都有着不错的水准。这台 NS150XC 同样延续了品牌一贯的设计功底，拥有出众的外观，静态品鉴部分我们已经看过，接下来，就一起来聊聊它的动态骑行表现究竟如何。 首先来看动力核心：搭载 149.7cc SH-EP 水冷四气门发动机。厂家结合国内路况、油品以及用户用车习惯，为这台跨界 ADV 踏板做了专属动力标定，最大功率 11.4kW，最大扭矩 14.4N・m，同时配备 PGM-FI 电喷系统。官方给出的百公里油耗为 2.35L，搭配 8L 油箱，综合续航有机会达到 350km 以上。这台发动机在耐用性、动力输出、震动控制与油耗之间找到了不错的平衡，也足以应对轻度非铺装场景。 起步阶段给油，低扭表现强劲，没有那种 “闷一下才发力” 的迟滞感，也不会猛地窜出去，动力输出循序渐进，是很典型的本田发动机调校风格。0-60km/h 加速区间提速响应很好，能带来可观的加速体感。堵车蠕行时，只需要小幅控制油门开合，跟车会比较轻松。整车车身轻巧、上手友好，在窄巷、城市街道穿梭也相对灵活。 当车速来到 60-80km/h 区间，动力依旧持续输出，只是加速力度会逐步放缓；稳定巡航之后风噪会有所增大，但发动机的震动控制依旧稳定，这个区间想要超车，依然有不错的动力储备，不用把油门拧到底就能完成超车动作；得益于双龙骨车架与中置油箱布局，高速巡航时车身稳定性很好，在这个速度区间快速变道，车身整体性强，跟随性较好，来回变道轻松可控。 车速超过 90km/h 之后，虽然说加速体感没有低扭那么强劲，但动力依旧还在继续往上走，毕竟这是一台偏向低扭取向的发动机，极速延展性并不是它的强项，而且城市通勤本身也不需要过快的速度；综合来看，流畅线性的动力衔接，加上充足的动力储备，应对市区蠕行跟车、快速路巡航完全够用。 当然，车辆拥有充足扭矩输出的同时，如果制动配置没能跟上，很容易带来安全隐患。NS150XC 在制动硬件上诚意十足，搭载日信前后制动卡钳，搭配前 240mm、后 220mm 浪花刹车碟盘，散热效果优秀，还能及时甩掉盘面附着的泥沙杂质，长时间制动不容易出现明显热衰。 实际跑山骑行中，不管是过弯减速还是紧急制动，这套刹车都能给到稳定的反馈。以 60km/h 的速度全力刹停，可以清晰感受到制动手把传来细腻且有节奏的弹跳反馈：前段介入力度轻柔顺滑，能够平稳降低车速；后段制动力更强，在轮胎即将抱死的临界状态把车辆安全刹停。不得不说，博世双通道 ABS 的介入时机恰到好处，整个制动过程。 关于这台车的弯道 ABS，我是深有体会。在进入山路跑山，压过一个较长的回头弯时，对向车辆突然变道超车，前方还有公交车遮挡视线，当时车身正处于倾斜过弯的姿态，我下意识捏紧刹车。如果没有弯道 ABS 加持，很大概率会侧滑摔车。弯道制动时，车身没有出现大幅度甩尾，很快平稳回正，原本的过弯线路也没有因为这次急刹被打乱。整套制动过程顺滑可控，不会出现车轮生硬锁死或是制动力突兀释放的情况。 可以说，NS150XC 的动力与刹车表现，都贴合它自身的产品定位。既能满足日常舒适通勤，周末也可以骑着短途跑山玩乐。不过作为一台跨界 ADV 运动踏板，进入非铺装路面后，就会开启另一番玩乐体验。 驶入林间小道、碎石烂路，长时间碾过坑洼、持续承受弹跳时，减震可以持续消化高频震动，过滤掉大部分颠簸，传递到身上的冲击感不算强烈。KYB 倒置前减震（行程 130mm）搭配 KYB 双气囊后减震，配上前 14 寸、后 13 寸的玛吉斯全地形龟背胎，让它拥有 165mm 的离地间隙。快速通过小幅高低差路面，车轮落地瞬间，减震有充足的压缩行程承接冲击，回弹干脆利落，减少二次弹跳，不会有硬碰硬的生硬撞击感。 轮胎碾过大块碎石时，深邃胎纹可以咬合住凹凸不规则的石面，抓地表现稳定。从长下坡快速冲过水坑时，依托双三星连板结构，车头稳定可控，车架刚性表现亮眼。就算连续碾过坑洼，整车姿态依旧可控；这套双三星车架结构，不容易被碎石冲击带动车头打手、跑偏，车辆更好掌控。如果想要进一步拓展玩乐场景，后期可以考虑更换辐条轮毂，滤震效果和抗冲击强度都会有进一步提升。 综合来说：在城市道路骑行轻巧灵活，而轻度越野路况，更能体现这台车完整的调校实力。它可以兼顾日常通勤，也能让你享受骑行的洒脱乐趣。 不难看出，新大洲本田在踏板车研发上，持续围绕舒适骑行与高安全性打磨，在踏板赛道不断推出差异化产品。不管是外观设计，还是发动机、电控的调校，都保持着不错的竞争力，持续丰富自身踏板产品线。 而 NS150XC 的意义，不只是把高端硬件下放到小排量踏板上。它既能让日常通勤变得畅快，也能在假期带着我们去体验不一样的乐趣。面对当下快节奏的生活，这台车的价值，也在提醒我们慢下来，不必时刻全身心扑在工作上，适时释放积攒的压力。当你厌倦千篇一律的通勤路线，大可调转车头驶向山间野林，让紧绷的身心得到放松。

signals.title: 中国踏板出海新样本：猎变Nomad即将亮相米兰，硬派跨界写出“国际表达”
signals.summary: 一年一度的米兰展临近，国内不少摩托车品牌已经开始动作。米兰国际两轮车展作为全球两轮行业的风向标，每年此时，谁去、带什么去、以什么姿态去，也是国内摩托圈层关注的话题。 这几年，国内踏板市场已经将配置、价格、服务卷了个遍，国产也好、合资也罢，拿出来的东西越来越相似，真正能被记住的差异却越来越少。当参数竞赛打到边际收益见底，下一个能拉开差距的地方，或许就是“玩法”。 而这恰恰是猎变一直在做的事。一直以来，猎变就是以“原创、安全、年轻当燃不将就”的态度造车。 这次米兰展，猎变也要去。除了旗下的热销车型，这次它将带去的，是一台代表这套造车态度的新作品——350cc踏板Nomad。 喜欢玩车、热爱机车的车友肯定知道，这台车已经在今年重庆摩博会上亮过相。所以米兰对Nomad来说不是“第一次见人”，而是走向国际舞台的下一站。 过去中国踏板出海，主流打法是性价比和配置堆料，能在国际舞台上被记住的，往往是价格标签。但这几年国内踏板市场本身在分化：代步之外，越来越多人把两轮当成生活方式的一部分。而所谓生活方式，很多时候不是一台两轮单独完成的——四轮把人和装备带到远方，两轮再在目的地周边随性游走，这就是“4+2”。Nomad要展现的，正是这套玩法：各种场景都能从容切换。 而它能这么适配，说到底来自猎变对机车的另一种理解：把机车当宠物，而不是通勤工具——这是猎变品牌一直以来对所有车型的定位。“机械宠物”这四个字不是修辞，是把车从“交通工具”重新定义成“有性格、能陪伴、可表达”的出行伙伴：宠物是有情绪的，是要能替主人说话的。Nomad则是这套品牌主张下又一个产品落点——车头的DIY屏支持自定义文字、图案，是一台可以“替你说话”的机械宠物。 但“机械宠物”不能只有情绪，还得有撑得起场景的硬实力。Nomad的底气，在于它没把“玩乐”做成一句空话： 原厂自带的一体化融合体护杠，不光是一种个性的表达，在实用性上也不含糊；钛金属搭配则给了它不容易撞色撞款的高级质感。虽然目前我们暂未得知这款车的配置参数，但参考猎变旗下其他在售车型的一贯水准，Nomad的诚意大概率也不会让人失望。 不过，在猎变看来，无论配置表拉得多长，都不只是为了秀参数，而是为了服务于真实的骑行场景。这台车不只是为通勤高峰设计的，更是为“没有路线，只有向往”的随性时刻设计的。硬派跨界写出“国际表达”，靠的不是把参数表翻译成英文，也不是去跟谁比配置，而是去告诉国际舞台：中国踏板还能这么玩，让每一项配置都指向一种具体的生活方式。 从这个角度看，“出海新样本”说的不是猎变带了一台新车去米兰，而是带去“4+2”这套全新的踏板玩乐思路。中国品牌开始用自己的生活方式语言参与国际对话——这就是“出海新样本”的实际所指，也是“写出国际表达”的真正分量。 米兰展即将开启，Nomad的展台表现值得国内摩托圈层提前关注。对于喜欢4+2出行、钓鱼、露营、追日落、山野短途骑行的人来说，这台车走向国际舞台，某种意义上也是这套玩法的一次“被看见”。

signals.title: NG Brakes' Premium range goes all black
signals.summary: Specialising in braking system components, the Spanish manufacturer NG Brakes is expanding its catalogue with a new range of discs designed for high-end motorbikes and scooters. The Premium range combines an exclusive finish with enhancements to the geometry and machining of the components, focusing on durability, fatigue resistance and braking performance. The first thing that catches the eye is the Black Finish treatment , which coats the disc’s core and edges. As well as its aesthetic appeal, the finish offers additional protection against moisture, the elements and washing, helping to prevent premature oxidation. The most interesting innovations, however, concern the structure. NG Brakes has redesigned the steel core , modifying the material’s internal stresses and heat dissipation channels. The aim? To achieve greater structural rigidity combined with more effective heat dissipation, so as to maintain the disc’s geometry stable even under the most demanding conditions of use. The braking surface has also undergone high-precision machining. The aim is to ensure optimal engagement with the brake pads, reducing vibration and noise whilst guaranteeing a progressive response, without compromising on firm bite. All discs in the Premium range are TÜV-approved and available for numerous models of scooters, maxi-scooters, naked bikes, sports bikes and adventure bikes. Recommended applications include the Yamaha TMAX, Kawasaki Z900 and Ducati Panigale. signals.title: Yamaha YZ250F 2027: engine and chassis overhauled
signals.summary: For 2027, Yamaha has carried out a major overhaul of the YZ250F: a new engine, frame and suspension derived from the YZ450F, alongside a revised transmission and an updated braking system. The 2027 Yamaha Off-Road Competition range has been updated with a substantial overhaul of the YZ250F, affecting the engine, chassis and components. The single-cylinder engine features a new rocker-arm valve train, a compression ratio increased from 13.8:1 to 14.1:1 and a top-end rev limit of 700 rpm. The crankshaft, piston and intake system have also been revised, whilst the transmission has been reinforced and the clutch is now hydraulic. The aluminium perimeter frame and Kayaba suspension are based on those of the YZ450F, with settings specifically tuned for the quarter-litre model. The rear shock absorber features a new base valve, whilst the rear brake now uses a 220 mm disc, down from the previous 240 mm. Traction control and Launch Control have also been updated, alongside adjustments via the Power Tuner app. Rounding off the updates are the redesigned bodywork and new graphics, shared with the YZ450F and also available in the Monster Energy Edition. signals.title: The Trip, the new 500 roadster ushers in a new generation of Moto Guzzi
signals.summary: There ’ s a breath of revolution at the Moto Guzzi stand at EICMA 2026, where the star of the show is The Trip 500. This twin-cylinder roadster features a parallel-twin engine and is aimed at a younger audience than the brand ’ s traditional customer base. Its styling evolves the brand ’ s signature design cues while retaining a clear family feeling, thanks to the shapes of the 15-litre fuel tank, side panels and headlight, whose light signature reinterprets the brand ’ s iconic eagle motif. Behind the headlight sits a 3.6-inch circular TFT display that can be connected to a smartphone. Backlit switchgear completes the cockpit. Power comes from a 48 hp parallel-twin engine, which falls within the limits for A2 licence holders. To make the most of this power, riders can opt between three riding modes: Road, Sport and Rain. The six-speed gearbox is also equipped with a Quick Shifter. The chassis features a newly developed steel frame, upside-down front forks and a pair of adjustable shock absorbers. Two figures in the technical specifications deserve particular attention: the weight, at 180 kg, and the seat height, at 790 mm. The Trip will be available in early 2027 in three colours: Green Grove, Black Metropolis and Red Beat. The range will also include a special edition, the The Opening. signals.summary: This major milestone from MIVV builds upon the 2026 launch of the HR-1 line—featuring dual slip-on mufflers paired with headers for Harley-Davidson Touring models—which made its world debut at the last edition of EICMA. Now, MIVV returns to the Milan motorcycle show with the standout HR-1 slip-on muffler , custom-engineered for H-D Street Bob, Low Rider S/ST, and Heritage Classic models. signals.summary: GR1T returns to EICMA for the third time, showcasing its most extensive electric motorcycle line-up to date. Alongside the G1S Street in a new colour scheme, the German start-up, which has made Italy its home, is presenting two new versions of its G1 electric motorcycle. The G1XR Raider features reinforced racks with a payload capacity of up to 190 kg, additional powertrain waterproofing, and leg and hand protection. These features make it ideal for first responders, police forces and firefighters, who can also rely on an infrared night-vision camera. The G1M Mission , meanwhile, stands out with its extended rear frame. This design allows it to carry a passenger or additional cargo, such as equipment or spare batteries, with the option of adding side racks. This version is also aimed at commercial fleets. All G1 Series models share more than 85% of their components , including the frame, motor, removable battery and wheel size. The electric motor delivers a rated power output of 11 kW, making the G1 models accessible to 16-year-olds holding an A1 licence. Peak power reaches 36 hp, enabling a top speed of 130 km/h. signals.summary: Ariete, back to EICMA for its 51st time , presents NIDEX, an ultra-technical and customizable handlebar grip. signals.title: EICMA 2026, FIRST PREVIEW OF THE “SPEED LEGENDS” EXHIBITION: THE QUEENS OF SPEED AND MOTOGP™ EXPERIENCES UP FOR GRABS
signals.summary: From the AJS Porcupine to the bikes ridden by Agostini, Rossi, Stoner and Márquez: some of the stars of the special exhibition in Hall 22 are revealed. The partnership with MotoGP™ also brings gaming, simulators and competitions offering the chance to experience the 2027 Mugello and Misano Grands Prix from the paddock. Extraordinary motorcycles, the stories of legendary champions and the chance to win a weekend in the paddock. MotoGP™ has chosen EICMA as the stage on which to celebrate its heritage and connect with fans: for the first time, the world’s premier motorcycle racing championship will take centre stage at the International Two-Wheeler Exhibition with a dedicated project. Just days before EICMA 2026 opens its doors, some of the motorcycles featured in Speed Legends, the special exhibition dedicated to the history of the premier class of the FIM Grand Prix World Championship, conceived by EICMA, are being unveiled. Following the success of the exhibition celebrating EICMA’s 110th anniversary in 2024 and Desert Queens, dedicated to the history of the Dakar Rally last year, EICMA presents a new journey through the legends of motorcycle racing. The exhibition will be open to the public from 5 to 8 November at Fiera Milano Rho, in Hall 22. Created in collaboration with MotoGP™, under the patronage of the FIM and with the support of ICE – Italian Trade Agency, Speed Legends is one of the key highlights of the partnership between EICMA and MotoGP™, announced at Mugello and developed through the EICMA.SHIFT UP project. Alongside the exhibition, the partnership brings gaming, simulators and competitions offering the chance to win exclusive experiences in the paddock at the 2027 Mugello and Misano Grands Prix. THE FIRST MOTORCYCLES REVEALED: FROM THE EARLY DAYS OF THE WORLD CHAMPIONSHIP TO MOTOGP™ LEGENDS Covering approximately 1,400 square metres, Speed Legends will trace the evolution of the premier class through more than 30 motorcycles, the achievements of legendary riders and the technical innovations that have shaped its different eras. The first motorcycles to be unveiled offer a preview of an exhibition featuring some of the most fascinating and iconic machines in competitive motorcycling. Highlights include the AJS Porcupine, the bike on which Leslie Graham won the inaugural 500cc World Championship title in 1949; the Moto Guzzi V8, one of the most remarkable engineering achievements in racing history; and the MV Agusta machines associated with Giacomo Agostini and Phil Read. The journey continues with Franco Uncini’s Suzuki XR40, Mick Doohan’s Honda NSR and Kevin Schwantz’s Suzuki RGV—motorcycles that played leading roles in seasons and rivalries still remembered by fans. The exhibition will also feature lesser-known rarities and unconventional technical solutions, showcasing the ingenuity and experimentation that have shaped the history of the premier class. The MotoGP™ era will be represented, among others, by Casey Stoner’s Ducati Desmosedici GP8, the Yamaha YZF-M1 machines ridden by Valentino Rossi and Jorge Lorenzo, and Marc Márquez’s Honda RC213V. These are just some of the motorcycles visitors will be able to admire at Speed Legends: a unique opportunity to get up close to the evolution of racing technology and relive the achievements of champions who have become part of the collective imagination. From legendary motorcycles to the excitement of future Grands Prix. Along Corso Italia, within the exhibition grounds, and at the exit of the exhibition in Hall 22, the customised cubes of the Win Corners will invite visitors to scan dedicated QR codes and enter competitions to win exclusive experiences at the Italian Grand Prix at Mugello and the San Marino and Rimini Riviera Grand Prix at Misano in 2027. Each winner and one guest will receive paddock access for the entire race weekend, together with a special activity at the heart of MotoGP™—an opportunity to experience the championship and its stars up close. SIMULATORS AND CHALLENGES IN THE MOTOGP™ GAMING ARENA The experience continues in the MotoGP™ Gaming Arena, where visitors can take the controls of simulators featuring real motorcycles and test their skills on the Mugello and Misano circuits in the MotoGP™26 video game. To complete the offering, visitors will also have the chance to win official MotoGP™ merchandise, making this an engaging experience for fans of all ages and an opportunity to introduce younger audiences to the world of motorcycle racing. EICMA 2026 will be open to the public from Thursday 5 to Sunday 8 November, from 9:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m., at Fiera Milano Rho. 3 and 4 November will be reserved for the press and trade visitors. signals.title: Satu DC Charger Layani 165 Mobil Listrik, Antrean SPKLU Jadi Sorotan
signals.summary: Satu DC Charger Layani 165 Mobil Listrik, Antrean SPKLU Jadi Sorotan JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Pertumbuhan jumlah mobil listrik di Indonesia perlu diimbangi dengan penambahan infrastruktur pengisian daya. Sebab, semakin banyak kendaraan listrik yang beroperasi, semakin besar pula kebutuhan terhadap Stasiun Pengisian Kendaraan Listrik Umum, terutama fast charging atau ( SPKLU ) pengisian cepat. Head of BYD Flash Charging , Ubaedilah, membuka, berdasarkan data yang digunakannya, saat ini terdapat sekitar 264.000 kendaraan listrik. Jika dibandingkan dengan jumlah DC charger, rasionya mencapai 1 banding 165. Baca juga: Lebih dari 10 Tahun, Daihatsu Dukung Konservasi Penyu di Bali "Kalau kita lihat berdasarkan rasio, dari 264.000 kendaraan EV kemudian dibandingkan dengan charger, DC charger, maka pada tahun 2026 ini rasionya 1 banding 165 (unit)," ujar Ubaedilah di Periklindo EV Conference (PEVC), di Jakarta, Rabu (28/10/2026). Kondisi tersebut berpotensi menimbulkan antrean, terutama ketika banyak pengguna membutuhkan pengisian daya pada waktu bersamaan. "Artinya, satu DC charger digunakan untuk 165 kendaraan. Bisa dibayangkan berapa lama antreannya," katanya. Dok. Voltron SPKLU Voltron di Puri Indah menawarkan 24 titik pengisian dengan teknologi ultra fast charging dan akses 24 jam. Menurut Ubaedilah, persoalan tersebut belum termasuk waktu yang dibutuhkan untuk mengisi baterai setiap kendaraan. Ia menyebutkan, rata-rata pengisian menggunakan DC charger saat ini membutuhkan waktu sekitar satu jam. "Saya masih belum bicara soal lamanya waktu pengecasan, tetapi bisa dibayangkan berapa lama antreannya. Padahal, target dari pemerintah sendiri adalah 1 banding 17 (unit) pada 2026," ucapnya. Selain jumlah fasilitas pengisian daya, durasi pengecasan juga menjadi salah satu tantangan dalam penggunaan mobil listrik. Baca juga: DFSK Kenalkan Emblem Baru Kendaraan Komersialnya di PEVS 2026 Ubaedilah mengatakan, rata-rata waktu pengisian menggunakan DC charger saat ini mencapai sekitar satu jam. Bahkan, dalam kondisi tertentu, prosesnya bisa berlangsung lebih lama. "Kemudian, kalau bicara soal lama waktu pengecasan, rata-rata semua DC charger, saya ambil rata-rata itu di 1 jam. Bahkan, bisa lebih juga, tetapi rata-ratanya satu jam," kata Ubaedilah. Bilhaq Sakti, KOMPAS.com Antrean mobil listrik di SPKLU Durasi tersebut bisa berbeda-beda, bergantung pada kapasitas baterai, daya maksimal yang bisa diterima kendaraan, kemampuan charger, serta kondisi baterai saat pengisian dimulai. Misalnya, mobil listrik yang memiliki kemampuan menerima daya hingga 100 kW belum tentu selalu mengisi dengan daya sebesar itu. Sebab, proses pengisian biasanya mengalami penurunan daya ketika kapasitas baterai semakin penuh. Kondisi tersebut membuat pengembangan infrastruktur pengisian daya perlu berjalan beriringan dengan pertumbuhan populasi kendaraan listrik. signals.title: Honda Minta Pemerintah Konsisten soal Insentif Hybrid
signals.summary: Honda Minta Pemerintah Konsisten soal Insentif Hybrid JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com PT Honda Prospect Motor (HPM) menyambut positif wacana pemerintah untuk memberikan insentif bagi kendaraan ramah lingkungan, termasuk mobil hybrid, plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV), dan range extended electric vehicle (REEV). Sales & Marketing Director PT Honda Prospect Motor ( HPM ) Yusak Billy mengatakan, dukungan pemerintah melalui insentif fiskal maupun nonfiskal dapat membuat harga kendaraan lebih kompetitif sehingga konsumen memiliki lebih banyak pilihan. "Kami menyambut positif dan menyambut baik wacana dari pemerintah untuk memberikan dukungan ataupun insentif fiskal maupun nonfiskal untuk kendaraan ramah lingkungan emisi rendah," kata Billy, saat ditemui di Tangerang, Kamis (29/10/2026). Baca juga: MAB Usulkan Insentif buat Kendaraan Komersial "Jadi seperti hybrid, plug-in hybrid, REEV, itu kan kendaraan ramah lingkungan. Kalau diberi dukungan dan insentif kan harga lebih bersaing. Konsumen lebih banyak pilihan. Industri otomotifnya bisa tumbuh," lanjutnya. KOMPAS.com/DIO DANANJAYA Honda Step WGN e:HEV dalam ajang Merapah Trans Jawa 2026 Menurut Billy, insentif untuk kendaraan elektrifikasi tidak hanya berpotensi meningkatkan penjualan kendaraan, tetapi juga mendorong pertumbuhan industri otomotif nasional secara keseluruhan. Pasalnya, kendaraan hybrid, PHEV, dan REEV masih menggunakan sejumlah komponen yang juga terdapat pada mobil bermesin pembakaran internal atau internal combustion engine (ICE). Dengan demikian, peningkatan permintaan terhadap kendaraan tersebut diharapkan turut mendorong pertumbuhan industri komponen dan ekosistem pendukung otomotif di Indonesia. "Yang diharapkan dari sini kan, dengan industri otomotif tumbuh karena harga bersaing dan banyak pilihan bagi konsumen untuk bisa memilih kan industri otomotif kan naik. Dan karena hybrid, plug-in, REEV itu kan menggunakan komponen seperti ICE. Jadi ekosistem industri pendukung pasti naik. Secara umum, bagus untuk pertumbuhan ekonomi Indonesia," ujar Billy. Baca juga: Lebih dari 10 Tahun, Daihatsu Dukung Konservasi Penyu di Bali Meski demikian, Billy mengatakan, pembahasan mengenai bentuk insentif fiskal masih berlangsung sehingga belum dapat dibicarakan lebih jauh. Ia menilai, selain dukungan yang diberikan pemerintah, kepastian dan konsistensi kebijakan dalam jangka panjang juga menjadi hal penting bagi industri otomotif. Hal ini berkaitan dengan pengembangan model kendaraan baru serta keputusan investasi yang membutuhkan perencanaan berkelanjutan. "Tapi yang pasti perlu konsistensi kebijakan jangka panjang, karena pengembangan new model, investasi, itu perlu perencanaan jangka panjang yang berkesinambungan. Jadi kalau itu dijalankan, sebaiknya ada kepastian dan konsistensi dari kebijakan jangka panjang," kata Billy. KOMPAS.com/STANLY RAVEL Honda Step WGN e:HEV GIIAS 2025 Pemerintah melalui Kementerian Perindustrian (Kemenperin) saat ini tengah membahas usulan insentif untuk kendaraan hybrid atau hybrid electric vehicle (HEV), PHEV, dan REEV. Skema yang dikaji mencakup dukungan fiskal maupun nonfiskal. Untuk insentif nonfiskal, sejumlah opsi yang diusulkan antara lain pengecualian dari aturan ganjil genap, kemudahan administrasi kendaraan, serta penyediaan fasilitas parkir khusus di wilayah perkotaan. Sementara itu, besaran dan mekanisme insentif fiskal, termasuk kemungkinan keringanan pajak, masih memerlukan pembahasan lebih lanjut bersama kementerian terkait. signals.title: Penjualan Gran Max Melesat: Efek E-commerce, Logistik, dan MBG
signals.summary: Penjualan Gran Max Melesat: Efek E-commerce, Logistik, dan MBG DENPASAR, KOMPAS.com Penjualan kendaraan komersial Daihatsu Gran Max mencatatkan pertumbuhan signifikan dengan kenaikan lebih dari 50 persen dibandingkan periode tahun sebelumnya. Peningkatan tersebut didorong oleh pertumbuhan sejumlah sektor usaha, mulai dari perdagangan elektronik atau e-commerce , industri logistik, hingga program strategis pemerintah yang membutuhkan kendaraan operasional. signals.title: Hasil FP1 Moto3 GP Malaysia, Veda Ega Pratama Tembus Empat Besar
signals.summary: Hasil FP1 Moto3 GP Malaysia, Veda Ega Pratama Tembus Empat Besar JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com Pebalap Indonesia Veda Ega Pratama tampil mengesankan pada sesi latihan bebas pertama (FP1) Moto3 GP Malaysia yang berlangsung di Sirkuit Sepang, Jumat (30/10/2026). Pebalap Honda Team Asia tersebut berhasil mengamankan posisi keempat di akhir sesi. Ajang GP Malaysia menjadi panggung kebangkitan para pebalap Moto3 setelah akhir pekan lalu seluruh balapan di Sirkuit Phillip Island, Australia, batal digelar akibat kendala cuaca buruk. Sesi FP1 di Sepang sendiri berjalan dalam kondisi lintasan kering meski dibayangi cuaca berawan. Veda mengawali FP1 dengan cermat. Putaran-putaran awal, pebalap muda asal Gunungkidul ini sempat tertahan di posisi ke-20. Namun, secara bertahap ia mampu mempertajam catatan waktunya hingga naik ke posisi ke-18, sebelum memanfaatkan towing di belakang pebalap tuan rumah, Hakim Danish, untuk merangsek ke posisi sembilan sebelum jeda pertengahan sesi. Maximo Quiles sempat memimpin daftar pebalap tercepat dengan waktu 2 menit 11,714 detik, sementara Veda berada di posisi ke-15 dengan selisih 1,711 detik. Menjelang menit-menit akhir sesi, Veda melakukan lonjakan signifikan. Ia membukukan waktu 2 menit 12,208 detik yang melesatkannya ke posisi empat sementara, sekaligus memangkas jarak ke posisi puncak menjadi tersisa 0,4 detik.
